reviewMethod: one indexed literary use and three rechecked question bands

changes.rationale: Zola says “en inconscient, je veux le croire”: he depicts an unwitting participant, not necessarily someone reckless. The early choice now tests lack of awareness; the completion and identification questions also test not grasping consequences. The historical nominal use and adjectival uses retain the same learner meaning.

before.reason: In en inconscient, inconscient is used in a compressed construction meaning unwittingly; its adjectival status and gloss need confirmation.
